name: Traffic Safety Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  April 13, 2011
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  4:00 PM

Upon request, the agenda can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a
disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at
378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or
accommodation.

The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday, April
26, 2011. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the Council with their
concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask the
Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item from the
Consent Calendar for discussion.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety
Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda
unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

OLD BUSINESS
1. Review of the Lunada Bay Plaza Parking Modifications

2. Review of Modified Turn Restrictions for 360-396 Palos Verdes Drive West Neighborhood.

NEW BUSINESS
3. Review of Speeds on Via Lopez.

RESIDENT LETTERS
4. None.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE
5. None

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on April 26, 2011.
 MINUTES
6. Meeting of February 9, 2011

ADJOURNMENT TO May 11, 2011

  Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative
  formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City
Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on April 26, 2011.
